claim_boundary: The kit executes object-level cases and reproduces its own outputs; it is one implementation, with a library (cbor2) as the second encoder. No runtime protocol, transport, network benchmark, or independent interoperability result is supplied. Speed figures are compression measurements and a first-order model, not network measurements.
